import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    g = np.exp(-params[7]*(P-params[8])**2)
    return params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*P + params[3]*P**2 + params[4]*P**3 + (params[5] + params[6]*t)*g + params[9]*t*P
